title: Luc discover
summary: One of the fixed English declarations the Runtime gives the Video model. Change these four declarations and docs/luc/agent-protocol.md together.

replaceability.why: These four declarations are the Luc-agent protocol itself: every agent, Lumeri's own or a reviewed stand-in, reaches every Luc through them, and the protocol keeps them the same under a stand-in. A replacement would redefine the protocol rather than implement it, so only Lumeri changes them, together with docs/luc/agent-protocol.md.
replaceability.decided: Lead review 2026-10-23 under charter rule 6 (stricter class while unsure, pending Acrab); docs/luc/agent-protocol.md:40-43

operations.name: luc_discover

items.description: Unavailable capability/package readiness rows. See iface:luc.bootstrap/v1.

operations.notes: No deadline is enforced. Query only ranks candidates; more has no pagination cursor. Empty query lists by id; limit defaults to 8. Optional count fields are omitted at zero. Errors raised here are ToolRefused; the turn wraps them into its error answer.

bounds.name: agent_result_chars
bounds.unit: characters of compact JSON before turn-level clipping

invariants.text: Discovery removes whole rows until the result fits 6000 characters, and more/more_unavailable count omitted rows.

break: the operation raises unexpectedly or returns an answer outside its declared schema
failure.notes: No replacement seam or run-time interface validator exists for this role today; the class describes who may eventually replace it.

conformance.notes: Existing tests are evidence for the named invariants, not a replacement conformance runner. Only the area contract checker is run in this task.

known_deviations.text: The declaration bounds query to 500 characters and forbids unknown fields; discover itself checks type, English and limit but does not enforce query length or reject unknown fields.

description.const: Discover available verified Luc capabilities by their descriptions and protocols. Write the query as English keywords, for example 'trim clip'; names and descriptions are English. The best matches come first; 'more' counts the ones not listed. 'unavailable' names what is switched on but cannot be used now, and why.
